decision.llm_reasoning: The course content explicitly includes 'Graphic Language and Graphic Genres' and 'Application of Graphics in Industrial Product Design', which involves applying visual techniques and graphical elements.

evidence.text: This course studies the application of fine arts in engineering fields and daily life. Upon completion, students will understand basic concepts of fine arts, including the history of Vietnamese and world art; the language and genres of painting, sculpture, and graphics; formative elements; graphic design, and industrial design, thereby creating industrial products with optimal aesthetic appeal.
